sourceOccurrences.label: Sharpness and the supercritical bound
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Proof of the finite-susceptibility and density conclusions
sourceOccurrences.note: HATE first reduces the long-range escape event to a finite wired graph. L0TE identifies the finite-size and percolation thresholds via an integrated differential inequality. Critical nonpercolation and spatial exponential decay are not asserted. RDF0 proves finite-susceptibility equivalence and critical left blow-up, without asserting critical percolation or its absence.
